title: Fault Lines – China’s navy mobilises, Marines in Manila, PNG’s LNG | The Strategist
paragraphs: Welcome to the latest edition of ASPI’s Fault Lines.
Every fortnight, ASPI’s Defence Strategy Program monitors the actions and developments shaping the regional order and Australia’s security.
This edition covers the period 30 October 2026 to 12 November 2026. Subscribe here to receive every edition of Fault Lines direct to your inbox.
